propositions: ADR 0035 §(d) must specify the concrete backend interface with four pinned decisions: canonical model, diff/apply ownership, role Protocols behind Backend facade, and RemoteRef type
The reconciliation seam shall use rebar's local ticket as the canonical model with no separate parallel schema, and adapters shall translate vendor to/from local using existing mappers
Five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) plus three optional capability Protocols shall be unified behind a Backend facade abstraction
A new RemoteRef type (vendor, instance, remote_id) shall replace hardcoded vendor literals and bare vendor keys in apply_inbound_records.py
Documentation must specify the backend registry keyed on config.reconciler.backend, list three leak-fixes, and scope the first real second backend implementation to epic be74
